description:
Employment Type

Temporary-to-hire position providing maternity leave coverage. This role is expected to begin as a temporary assignment, with the potential to convert to a regular full-time position based on business needs, performance, and organizational approval. Conversion is not guaranteed.

Role Title: Product & Project Marketing Specialist

Reporting to: Sr. Director of Product and Program Marketing 

Location: United States

Role Purpose:

Jumio is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Product & Project Marketing Specialist to support our growing product marketing team. This role is ideal for someone with strong project or program management experience in enterprise software who is looking to transition into or grow within product marketing. You will work closely with our Product Marketing Director to coordinate go-to-market efforts, manage launch execution, contribute to content creation, and help drive strategic initiatives across the organization. This is a high-growth opportunity in a fast-paced, bleeding-edge software company at the intersection of AI, identity, and cybersecurity. This is initially a defined-term role supporting a team member's leave, with strong potential to convert to permanent.

Role Value:

By joining Jumio’s marketing organization, you will:

  • Reduce operational overhead for senior team members, allowing them to focus on strategic impact
  • Help execute high-visibility initiatives that shape our go-to-market and product positioning
  • Gain exposure to the full product marketing lifecycle and grow into a more strategic role over time
  • Get hands-on exposure to a major product launch and Sales Kickoff planning, high-visibility work that builds your product marketing portfolio fast

Example Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of go-to-market projects, campaigns, and product launches
  • Coordinate with Product, Sales, Design, and other teams to ensure timely and effective deliverables
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Corporate Marketing on campaign execution and content support
  • Support Voice of Customer programs, including administration of customer feedback platforms (e.g., G2) and helping translate insights into messaging
  • Create and edit Google slides and supporting materials for executive and customer-facing use
  • Support competitive analysis and content rollout
  • Organize and run meetings with internal stakeholders and track action items
  • Conduct research (e.g., Gartner, market/competitive analysis) to inform positioning
  • Contribute to messaging, positioning, and enablement initiatives
  • Help build scalable processes for launch planning and cross-functional collaboration

Special Projects 

In addition to core responsibilities, this role will support several time-bound initiatives, including Sales Kickoff planning and content development, migration to a new Learning Management System, and launch support for a major upcoming product release.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • 3 – 5 years of experience in program/project management, product ops, or marketing ops within an enterprise software/SaaS company
  • Experience working in or supporting product or marketing functions
  • Experience supporting sales enablement content or large-scale sales events (e.g., SKO) 
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and/or product launch workflows a plus
  • Strong business sense, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and presenting to senior stakeholders
  • Ability to manage cross-functional projects from kickoff to completion, including timelines, stakeholders, deliverables, and follow-through. Precision, ownership, and proactiveness are key.
  • Familiarity with customer feedback or review platforms (e.g., G2) is a plus.

Key Characteristics and Attitudes 

In a recent global survey these attributes were valued by Jumios in all locations and functions - we firmly believe in hiring for mind-set as well as skill. 

  • Friendly and supportive
  • Adaptable and flexible
  • Articulate and persuasive
  • High IQ and EQ
  • Curious and coachable
  • Commercially Aware
  • Resilient and tenacious
  • Big picture and the detail

Jumio Values 

  • IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovatio

Company 
Jumio is the future for online and mobile ID verification. We are the largest and fastest growing company in the ID verification space. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and many more. 

Equal Opportunities 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We encourage applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

Compensation

This temporary position is expected to pay an hourly rate of $70 per hour, depending on location, skills, experience, and the final employment arrangement. Geographical adjustments may apply for Tier 1 locations.

 

Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

Equal Opportunities:

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

About Jumio:

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.
